author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am willing to accept a forecast that is slightly less accurate than the absolute best possible. The current manual tuning process is too slow and brittle for our nightly retraining cycle. I would rather ship a model that is fully automated and reproducible every night, even if it sacrifices a small percentage of predictive performance. This trade allows us to eliminate the human bottleneck in the pipeline and ensure that every deployment is consistent and traceable without requiring me to manually adjust parameters for each store cluster.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states a willingness to sacrifice a small percentage of predictive performance in exchange for automation, consistency, and the elimination of manual tuning bottlenecks.
